hook: Your dog flew to space before any human.
title: Your dog flew to space before any human
description:
In November 1957 the Soviet Union launched Laika aboard Sputnik 2. She was the first animal to orbit Earth, four years before Yuri Gagarin became the first human in space. Laika did not survive the mission.

#Shorts #Space #Laika
